verdict.rationale: There is no first-party documentation of a one-way data-flow model; the docs only list Pinia by title. Community reports suggest explicit flow is possible: the official store (Vuex) is described as a clean flux implementation, and child-to-parent communication requires explicit emits at each level. However, other developers report that two-way binding caused confusion about where state lives and about implicit state changes, and that patterns like parents setting a child's data muddy reasoning about data flow. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a one-way props-down/events-up data-flow model, documented guidance for avoiding implicit two-way binding, Pinia docs content on traceable state changes, and hands-on evidence that state changes are reliably traceable.
